title: Nonghyup to Absorb Loss-Making Retail Unit Hanaro Distribution
snippet: Nonghyup Agribusiness Group will absorb Hanaro Distribution on Jan. 1 after the unit posted a 111.3 billion won operating loss over three years. Published 2026
extractedText: Nonghyup to Absorb Loss-Making Retail Unit Hanaro DistributionBoard Vote Late This Month; Merger Set for Jan. 1 Partial Capital Erosion Since 2024, Reaching 19.1% Last Year Directly Run Hanaro Mart Stores May Move to Nonghyup Retail as Sales Organization Is UnifiedFinance|Published 2026.09.13. 06:00:05|By Hwang Dong-gunbrassgun@sedaily.com|Summary|SaveAAAHanaro Distribution, which operates Hanaro Mart and other outlets, will be absorbed into Nonghyup Agribusiness Group Holdings. Yonhap NewsNonghyup Agribusiness Group has decided to absorb Nonghyup Hanaro Distribution, aiming to lift operating efficiency by consolidating its retail operations, including Hanaro Mart stores, around Nonghyup Retail. The move brings the two back together about 12 years after Nonghyup spun off Hanaro Distribution as a separate company.Nonghyup Agribusiness Group will convene its board late this month to approve the merger, according to retail industry sources on the 12th. The merger is scheduled for Jan. 1 next year. Once the process is complete, Hanaro Distribution's workforce, assets and store operations will be transferred to the holding company, and the legal entity will be dissolved.Behind the decision is Hanaro Distribution's deteriorating performance. The company posted a combined operating loss of 111.3 billion won over the three years through last year. Revenue fell 8.6% to 1.1804 trillion won last year from 1.2915 trillion won in 2023. Over the same period, liabilities rose 35.9% to 288.5 billion won from 212.3 billion won. The company slipped into partial capital erosion in 2024, with the erosion rate more than doubling to 19.1% at the end of last year from 9.0% at the end of 2024.After the merger, Nonghyup is also considering handing over the operation of directly run Hanaro Mart stores to Nonghyup Retail, sources said. Under that arrangement, the holding company would handle headquarters functions such as purchasing and supply, while store sales would be concentrated at Nonghyup Retail.The merger is also seen as a step toward unifying what has been a two-company structure in Nonghyup's retail business, with the holding company taking on headquarters functions such as purchasing and supply and Nonghyup Retail handling frontline sales. Hanaro Distribution was launched in 2015. At the time, a plan to absorb other distribution affiliates into a single organization was pursued but never materialized. In 2021, three regional distribution companies were merged into Nonghyup Retail, and the retail division has operated under a two-company structure since."We are reviewing various measures to improve the performance of loss-making stores, and for those judged unlikely to recover, we may pursue steps such as converting them to other uses," a Nonghyup official said. "In that case, employees there will be reassigned to nearby stores or offices."#Nonghyup#HanaroMart#Merger#KoreanRetail#CapitalErosionOriginal reporting by Hwang Dong-gun for Seoul Economic Daily.AI-translated from Korean.
